inputs.scope: Unreleased prototype; full unchanged Flow Matching test suite, no profiling.

release_bridge: All prototype modules/resources identical except package __init__ version 0.14.0 -> 0.15.0; exact bytes asserted.
procedure: Completed diagnostic profile first; all actual timing series sequential, without correctness tests/builds/profiling. Fresh balanced ABBA processes per candidate, no removed/normalized samples. Node and Chrome are separate series.

profile.scope: Full unchanged 2000-step T3 training, sampling and metrics assertions; profiled diagnostic, not comparable benchmark.

inputs.scope: Frozen full 2000-step Flow Matching T3 test; cProfile diagnostic only, no comparative timing claims.

raw_kernel_comparisons.scope: Exploratory raw WASM forward linear kernels only; not library or full-workflow speedup. Fresh processes, sequential balanced ABBA per candidate, all raw samples retained.

raw_dispatch_comparisons.scope: Exploratory raw WASM forward linear kernels only; not library or full-workflow speedup. Fresh processes, sequential balanced ABBA per candidate, all raw samples retained.

selected_dispatch: WASM only, input feature count >=64, rows * weight.size >=32768, both input and weight feature strides equal itemsize. CPU BLAS, shorter features, small or feature-strided inputs preserve matmul.

reports.label: baseline
reports.scope: Full unchanged Flow Matching T0-T3 reference suite including 2000 training steps, 2000-point sampling and distribution metrics; runtime and package preparation excluded.

tests.why: 时间向量 [B] 应自动广播到任意样本维度。
确定性线性速度场固定了插值、损失和积分的数值约定。
单点数据下，条件速度恰好等于解析最优速度，回归误差应为零。
单点目标沿直线路径运动，Euler 一步即可到达。
高斯解析速度场将标准噪声推到指定均值与标准差的数据分布。
Euler 只在每段左端点求速度，不能在 t=1 的奇点求值。
插值端点固定，logit-normal 时间采样在 logit 空间满足指定高斯参数。
训练速度场必须能从噪声积分到八高斯数据，损失下降本身不足以验证采样方向。

chrome_full_flow.scope: Four balanced ABBA fresh entire Chrome processes and Workers; full unchanged Flow Matching suite; no profiling, all samples preserved; preparation excluded.

numerical_scope: The direct contraction changes floating-point reduction order. Full unchanged T0-T3 suites passed in all eight processes; coverage/outlier proportions exactly equal, MMD and loss/sample differences retained. This does not promise bitwise equality or remote deadline compliance.
compact_artifacts: All per-process and per-batch timing samples, test outcomes, loss curves, MMD and coverage preserved. Large sample coordinate arrays are SHA256-attested canonical JSON; raw complete reports retained in the local evidence directory.
known_tooling_corrections: First cProfile run completed training assertions but report export requested absent torch.__version__; reran with actual package version. Failed log retained.

Initial new tests incorrectly required an absent zero primal gradient, and used unit-variance weights producing cancellation outside an arbitrary fixed float32 absolute bound in both pre-existing CPU and WASM paths. Test now checks zero math derivative and uses 0.1-scale network weights. Final strict scalar-sum and native checks pass; original failed log retained.
